rationale: The stock is down roughly 12% from yesterday's close in a severe broad market selloff (SPY -4.16%, VIXY +27%), with price sitting at 33.8% of today's range and below VWAP ($359.02) and the 9-EMA ($357.18), suggesting continued downward pressure.
